calls.reason: The only evidence is the underspecification paper, which shows ML models often fail when deployed. It does not count touted breakthroughs or check them against their original promises, so the claim about how often this happens can't be called.

The Batch and The Register report that OpenAI shut its robotics team around October 2020, about a year after the cube demo. The closure only came out months later on a podcast, and the follow-up research stayed in simulation.

The evidence is mixed. Cruise's recall filing shows its driverless fleet was paused, but Waymo was running a paid driverless service in SF and Phoenix and reported favourable claims data. Whether that counts as 'prime time' depends on how the words are read.
